status: REAL REGISTERED MESH REFERENCE / NOT PRINTABLE / NO WHOLE ASSEMBLY ACCEPTANCE
frame: Current guide zero-joint world frame, trunk_base origin; X fore/aft, Y left/right, Z up. Positive Y left leg. No transform inferred from unrelated early humanoid STEP.

sourceVersionFinding.reason: 275-part earlier humanoid with shoulder/humerus/radius and pelvis/chest/trunk_top, not current duck. No valid whole-assembly registration.
sourceVersionFinding.nativeSource: Community 3MF meshes; registered through guide sourceTransformWorld and FK body transforms.

invariant: All vertices and relative transforms within each whole leg unchanged; corresponding fixed yaw rings moved too. Central mounting hardware must move with new interfaces; no designed replacement bridge yet.
legacyPowerOccupancy: Old power_support, converter and eleven-fuse carrier retained as visible obstacles only. Power architecture under review, not presumed retained.
omissions: Individual threaded screw bodies are not represented by the source mesh scene; screw attachment coordinates remain in the guide ledger.
BRep feature history unavailable for community printed solids; no faceted mesh misrepresented as analytic solid.

parts.name: Left thigh body
parts.description: Large open frame with two motor seats. The wide faces belong to the hip-pitch and knee motors. This is the LEFT version.

parts.name: Thigh reinforcing plate
parts.description: Very thin, flat, roughly triangular plate; only 1 mm thick. It spans the stationary case corners of both thigh motors.

parts.name: Lower-leg link
parts.description: Long narrow stepped link, about 58 mm long, with joint openings at both ends. One link per leg.

parts.name: Left ankle bracket
parts.description: Compact curved fork with a round motor-output opening and lower foot-pivot seats. Use the LEFT part, not the opposite ankle.

parts.name: Left foot
parts.description: One combined broad foot print with a raised pivot feature. The foot is a single part; do not look for a separate sole.

parts.name: Hip bracket
parts.description: Short bent bridge connecting the two perpendicular output faces: hip roll ID9 and hip pitch ID8.

parts.name: Yaw-to-roll link
parts.description: Short angled block with perpendicular motor interfaces and an integrated rear retainer.

parts.name: Roll support plate
parts.description: Tall, narrow plate, about 40 mm long and 3 mm thick. It closes the opposite side of the hip-roll motor case.

parts.name: 22 mm sliding ring · ID7
parts.description: Black printed annular support: 22 mm outside diameter, 4 mm wide. Three are used on this detached leg. Keep the molded sliding features; no extra metal bearing is required.

parts.name: 14.6 mm ankle ring
parts.description: Single black printed sleeve: 14.6 mm outside diameter, about 9.65 mm bore, 3 mm wide. Its inner fit on the lower-link Ø10 boss is tight in CAD; its outside has nominal clearance inside the orange ankle Ø15 pocket. Relative motion must occur at the outer interface if the sleeve stays with the link.
